tiers.name: bounded-single-route
requirements: one exact property and meaning source
one exact subject
explicit denominator and resource bounds
one trait-compatible real provider
exact tool, translation and input bindings
raw evidence and validated provider receipt
typed property outcome

tiers.name: bounded-corroborated
requirements: at least two independently implemented applicable provider routes over one obligation
non-voting comparison
disagreement and unknown remain visible non-success contract states

tiers.name: evidence-hardened
requirements: negative controls for subject, oracle, denominator, evidence and execution
freshness, replay, tamper, timeout and output-bound enforcement
degraded success forbidden
complete causal blocker reporting

tiers.name: trait-complete-multimethod
requirements: every declared property trait has its required provider capability
cross-provider obligation identity and assumption consistency
structural, relational, temporal, deductive and executable dimensions are required only when their traits apply

tiers.name: repair-assurance
requirements: natural counterexamples are distinguished from seeded calibration mutants
repair begins only after a confirmed counterexample and exact write scope
original counterexample, regression denominator and superficial-repair controls are rerun
author evidence is sealed before separate technical replay
reviewer records AGREE, DISAGREE or INCONCLUSIVE
repair, admission and deployment authority remain separate

fixture_policy: fixture evidence cannot satisfy a product verification tier
open_questions: Whether independently authored adapters sharing one semantic translation count as distinct V1 routes.
